name: Polymorph
long_description:
Polymorph is building the future of the consumer internet: one that adapts to each user and optimizes for delightful experiences by building agents that constantly run thousands of experiments that scale our customers' product ideas and brand.

Team has extensive startup, AI, and math backgrounds: 
- founding engineer at a unicorn
- ML infrastructure @ Scale AI (inference), AWS Bedrock (fine-tuning)
- ads engineering @ Meta & Twitch
- IMO & IOI medalists
one_liner: Building the future of consumer internet
